verdict: Only for a specialist team. Coratia Technologies from Rourkela pitched unmanned underwater robots on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Dams, ports, pipelines and ships need underwater inspection, but buyers are few and sales cycles are long.
angle: Underwater robots inspect dams, ships and pipelines without divers. Buyers are government bodies, ports and infrastructure companies. Inspection services can generate revenue before selling robots.
